race.comment: BRAVEHEART (3) continued his outstanding run of recent form when he led all the way and just held out BLAZING HARRY over this course and distance two weeks ago. Loses nothing with Youngberry going on. Hard to tip against in this sort of form. BLAZING HARRY (8) was fresh from a two-month let-up when he just failed to reel in BRAVEHEART here last time. Strips fitter, draws a far better gate, and gets a nice weight swing so he is a great chance to turn the tables. TRUE AMOR (7) is back after a 20-week lay-off. The winner of two from four when resuming and could easily add to that tally judging by a couple of impressive recent trial wins. ADDRIEL (5) is a handy gelding resuming and gets a key booking in Thompson. Have to keep onside.
